selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to make stronger?
questions.answer: His faith and his knowing of Allah.

questions.question: What two things bring that love?
questions.answer: Believing in Allah and knowing Allah.

questions.question: Where did he turn his attention next?
questions.answer: To the sky.

questions.question: Which is higher in his order: just being alive or being aware?
questions.answer: Being aware.

questions.question: What reason did he give for thinking the skies have inhabitants?
questions.answer: Since life is so precious, the great and beautiful heavens should also have living, spiritual, aware beings.

questions.question: Why did the traveler want to speak with the people of the heavens?
questions.answer: To learn what they say about the Creator.

questions.question: What did the heavenly voice say the angels believed first?
questions.answer: The truths of faith brought to the prophets, especially to Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What comparison shows how clear their agreement is?
questions.answer: It is like the brightness of the sun.

questions.question: What did the traveler know is the source of all true human goodness and excellence?
questions.answer: Love for Allah.

questions.question: What does that love grow from?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah and knowing Allah.

questions.question: What direction did he look when searching for another lesson?
questions.answer: Up to the heavens.

questions.question: Of all living creatures, which ones did he prize most?
questions.answer: Conscious ones.

questions.question: From that, what did he decide about the heavens?
questions.answer: That they have fitting inhabitants with life, spirit, and awareness.

questions.question: Who is given as the example of an angel appearing?
questions.answer: Gabriel, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What did the pure spirits say together about the Creator?
questions.answer: That Allah surely exists, is One, and has holy attributes.

questions.question: Why can their witness guide the traveler well?
questions.answer: Because so many of their messages match each other clearly.

questions.question: What was the traveler already aware of before looking at the heavens?
questions.answer: That the greatest perfection is loving Allah.

questions.question: How strongly did the traveler want to move forward?
questions.answer: With all his outer and inner strength.

questions.question: In his thinking, what is the most valuable thing in the universe?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: Which is more honored in his thinking: all living things or living things with awareness?
questions.answer: Living things with awareness.

questions.question: What conclusion did he draw from the value of life?
questions.answer: The heavens should also contain living, spiritual, conscious beings.

questions.question: What was the traveler wishing he could do?
questions.answer: Talk with the inhabitants of the heavens.

questions.question: What did the traveler most want to learn from the heavenly beings?
questions.answer: What they say about the Creator.

questions.question: What did all the pure spirits witness together?
questions.answer: Allah’s sure existence, His oneness, and His holy attributes.
